title.narrative: Salaam Support Group Project III in Afghanistan

description.narrative:
Denmark supports UNAMA and the Salaam Support Group (SSG) project under the Peace and Stabilisation funds. Since the Taliban seized power, the
SSG has primarily supported reconciliation and peace initiatives, with a focus on local-level cohesion, inclusive political settlements involving minorities, specifically the Hazara-community, as well as support to regional stabilisation efforts in areas with minority population groups.

In December 2022, the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) requested UNOPS to form phase III of the Salaam Support Group project, UNOPS is requested to provide support in fiduciary (financial) management and financial reporting.
